rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for food that has not been cooked.

example.english: This fish is still raw, so don’t eat it yet.
example.traditional: 呢塊魚仲生㗎，唔好食住。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 jyu4 zung6 saang1 gaa3 m4 hou2 sik6 zyu6

rows.note: Use this for materials or products not treated or refined, and for data or figures not cleaned or analysed.

example.english: These figures are raw and still need analysis.
example.traditional: 呢啲數據係未經處理，仲要分析先。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 sou3 geoi3 hai6 mei6 ging1 cyu2 lei5 zung6 jiu3 fan1 sik1 sin1

rows.note: Use this for a person who is new to something and lacks experience.

example.english: I’m raw at leading tours; it’s really my first time.
example.traditional: 我第一次帶團，真係冇經驗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 daai3 tyun4 zan1 hai6 mou5 ging1 jim6

rows.note: Use this when the quality, finish, or execution is rough, crude, or unsophisticated.

example.english: This report is raw and needs polishing.
example.traditional: 呢份報告寫得好粗糙，要執下。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 cou1 cou3 jiu3 zap1 haa5
